h2: NDT training near Casper: Wyoming college welding programmes, local inspection employers and online study compared
html:
NDT training near Casper: Wyoming college welding programmes, local inspection employers and online study compared

An "NDT training near me" search from Casper turns up welding schools and job ads more often than NDT schools. In our review of Wyoming college programmes for this page we did not find a dedicated NDT certificate; the nearest ones we verified are in Salt Lake City and Ogden, Utah, and in Kalispell, Montana. What Casper does have is a cluster of inspection employers that hire assistants and certified technicians for oil and gas, refining, power and fabrication work. These are the realistic routes, with what each one gives you and what it leaves out.

Who offers NDT training around Casper?

  • Casper College welding technology. The college's welding AAS covers welding process and theory, blueprint reading, welding symbols and industry codes and standards, taught by instructors who hold AWS certification and have weld-inspection backgrounds. It is a solid grounding for a later move into weld inspection, but it is not method training in UT, MT or PT.
  • Eastern Wyoming College, Torrington. EWC's welding schedule lists a three-credit Welding Inspection Technology course. Read the catalogue description for its content before treating it as NDT preparation.
  • Local inspection companies. High Mountain Inspection advertised an entry-level NDT technician assistant role in Casper in 2025, open to local applicants without NDT experience and naming UT, MT and PT among the methods. SCC Inspection, part of Sletten Companies, has advertised a Casper Level II position in MT, PT, UT and phased array UT requiring at least three years of NDT experience. Between them they show the local ladder: assistant, then Level I and II in the surface methods and UT, then phased array.
  • Out-of-state programmes. Salt Lake Community College offers an NDT Technology degree and Ogden-Weber Technical College a 32-credit non-destructive inspection programme. Flathead Valley Community College in Kalispell, Montana, describes a Welding and Inspection Technology degree that covers six NDT methods. Each means relocating for months, which many Casper candidates with jobs or families cannot do.

Which route fits you?

Your positionRoute that tends to work from CasperAsk about
No NDT job yet and living in CasperApply as an NDT assistant with a local inspection companyWhether the firm logs your training and experience hours from your opening day
Welder considering inspectionCasper College welding, then VT and MT, then UTWhether you also want the AWS CWI later in your career
Assistant or Level I adding methodsOnline theory for each method plus a practical with your employerThat the training record shows hours by method
Field service company certifying crewsTraining and Level III examinations at your own shop against your written practiceHow winter field schedules affect when training can happen

Searching for "welding inspection training" in Casper? Three different things hide behind that phrase. A welding programme teaches you to make sound welds and read codes. NDT method training teaches you to examine those welds with VT, MT, PT or UT under an employer's written practice. The AWS Certified Welding Inspector credential sits on top of both and has its own experience requirement and exam. Postings in central Wyoming often ask for a mix, so read each one closely and train for the combination it names rather than collecting courses at random. If you are counting how many classroom and experience hours your target level needs, the SNT-TC-1A hours planner lays them out by method.

Questions to ask before committing to NDT training near Casper

  • Does the course record list method, level, topics and hours so that a Wyoming employer's Level III can accept it without guessing?
  • Will you scan real welds, corroded pipe and forged parts, or only calibration blocks?
  • Who will certify you? Casper employers certify under their own written practices; ASNT certifies only through its central exams, and a course alone certifies nobody.
  • If radiography is the goal, how will you get the separate radiation-safety training your employer's licence requires?
  • Is phased array on your path? Most employers expect UT Level II and logged UT experience before phased array training is worth starting.

Where Atlantis fits for Casper candidates and employers

Atlantis has no school in Wyoming. The theory is online on the Atlantis portal and self-paced from the day you enrol, so a Casper technician can study between field days or when weather stops work, and an ASNT NDT Level III answers technical questions. Set-ups and scans are rehearsed in the Practical NDT simulator; the hands-on practical and its examination happen at your employer's shop or site, under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A, and your employer issues the certification. For the methods Casper postings name, see ultrasonic testing training, magnetic particle testing training and penetrant testing training, or begin with NDT Level 1 training.

This route suits an assistant already hired by a local firm, or a technician who needs another method on paper without leaving the job. A newcomer with no employer who wants months of lab time should look at the Utah or Montana programmes above. Welders aiming at inspection can add the six-day AWS CWI exam preparation course; AWS runs the exam and issues the certification. Inspection companies can ask for a quote to have their crews trained on site. Nearby pages: NDT training in Wyoming, Billings and Denver.
